identitySignals: Name matches: Motivāt Coffee Roasters is an Oakland coffee roaster and cafe, and the agenda names Motivat Coffee Roasters, LLC in Oakland, CA.
The company's own website (motivatcoffee.com) describes a Downtown Oakland coffee roaster that does wholesale and catering. That fits a business acting as an OUSD workplace training partner.
Weak: LinkedIn and the cafe's public listings place the business at 1528 Webster St, Oakland.
Not confirmed: I found no registry record for the LLC (California Secretary of State or SAM.gov), and no public page that links Motivāt to OUSD or the ECCCO program.
research.notes: Confidence is medium, so this should not be published as is. I could not reach the California Secretary of State or SAM.gov records, so the LLC's legal name, entity number and UEI are unverified. No public page links this business to OUSD or the ECCCO program. I left the phone and street address null. Third-party listings give three different phone numbers: (510) 671-1926, (510) 214-2252 and (510) 314-4475. The company's privacy policy gives the zip as 94541, while other listings give 1528 Webster St, Oakland, CA 94612. A reviewer should check the Secretary of State record and the OUSD memorandum of understanding.

profile.summary: Motivāt Coffee Roasters is a coffee roasting business based in Downtown Oakland, California. It sells roasted single-origin coffee, runs a coffee shop and cart, and offers wholesale and catering services across the San Francisco Bay Area.
